instruction: Navigate to the FlightAware discussions forum from the main site.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated from flightaware.com to discussions.flightaware.com, searched 'community', clicked 'FlightAware Community Discord?' thread, scrolled through it for many turns but never found the topic with most replies (The Banter Thread).
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate flightaware.com, find and click footer links, reach discussions.flightaware.com, use search, click discussion topics, scroll through threads.
metadata.failure_analysis: Model searched for keyword 'community' instead of sorting/browsing topics by reply count. Picked the first search result instead of identifying the topic with the most replies.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed original task to just the navigation sub-task: reaching the discussions forum. Model demonstrated this ability (screenshots 8-10).
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from flightaware.com main page to the discussions forum. Evaluator checks that the active URL matches discussions.flightaware.com using regex pattern matching.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (active_url_from_accessTree) correctly extracts the active tab URL, which is the right state to verify navigation.
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly receives the rules dict and checks URL against regex pattern.
Expected regex pattern 'https://discussions\.flightaware\.com' correctly identifies the FlightAware discussions forum URL.
Full coverage: the instruction only requires navigating to the discussions forum, and the URL pattern check fully verifies this.
